newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD falls on reports of AT & T discount services.
newsitem.headline: KDD falls on reports of AT & T discount services.

text.p: Shares in Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd fell in Tuesday morning trade, depressed by reports that AT & T Corp will begin international telephone services in Japan, setting its fees nearly 50 percent lower than those of Japanese operators, brokers said.
As of 0137 GMT, the shares were down 460 yen at 9,840, making the issue the largest percentage loser on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Japan's biggest international carrier Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co Ltd (KDD) said that AT&T Corp's entry into Japan's international call market would have little impact on its business.
"As far as corporate customers are concerned, there will be little difference in call tariffs offered by KDD and AT&T," a KDD spokesman said.
